nodes.name: PdfToMarkdownServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Converts PDFs to markdown by rendering each page to an image via PDFBox and sending it to a vision-capable LLM chat client for OCR/markdown extraction, concatenating page results.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Apache PDFBox for rasterizing PDF pages, then a Spring AI ChatClient with image media for vision-based markdown extraction per page.

nodes.name: RagDocumentServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements RagDocument lifecycle management: starting student transcript and global knowledge ingestion (with re-ingestion versioning), marking completion/failure, and computing SHA-256 checksums.

nodes.name: RagVectorStoreServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements vector store operations for RAG documents: replacing document chunks with metadata tags (document id, scope, source type) and deleting chunks via a direct JDBC delete.

nodes.name: SupabaseStorageServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements Supabase storage integration: uploads avatars, chat attachments, transcripts, and course materials via REST calls to Supabase's storage API, and issues signed URLs for course materials.

nodes.name: VirtualMentorServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements the AI virtual mentor: manages chat sessions, streams RAG-augmented chat responses using vector-store retrieval scoped by user permissions, and builds system prompts from student/user profile data.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines vector-store similarity search (RAG) with a Spring AI ChatClient to stream contextualized mentor responses, applying scope-based access control on retrieved documents.

nodes.name: FileValidationUtil.java
nodes.summary: Utility class validating uploaded files (images, PDFs, chat attachments) against allowed content types, extensions, and max size limits, throwing BadRequestException on violations.

nodes.name: RagDocumentServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests verifying RagDocumentServiceImpl starts student transcript ingestion with private scope/version 0, and correctly increments the ingestion version on re-ingestion of an existing document.

nodes.name: RagVectorStoreServiceTest.java
nodes.summary: Unit tests for RagVectorStoreServiceImpl covering chunk replacement metadata tagging and chunk deletion behavior.

nodes.name: VirtualMentorServiceSecurityContextTest.java
nodes.summary: Security-focused unit tests validating VirtualMentorServiceImpl correctly resolves the authenticated user from the security context and enforces access rules across chat operations.

nodes.name: PdfToMarkdownServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation rendering PDF pages to images and using a vision LLM to extract markdown content per page, then concatenating results.

nodes.name: processPages
nodes.summary: Renders all PDF pages to images and converts each to markdown via the vision LLM, appending per-page markers and handling per-page failures gracefully.

nodes.name: renderPdfToImages
nodes.summary: Loads a PDF with PDFBox and renders each page to a PNG byte array at a configured DPI.

nodes.name: convertPageToMarkdown
nodes.summary: Sends a single rendered page image to the vision-capable chat client with a fixed OCR/markdown prompt and returns the extracted markdown text.

nodes.name: RagDocumentServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation managing RagDocument creation/versioning for transcripts and global knowledge, plus status updates and checksum computation.

nodes.name: startStudentTranscript
nodes.summary: Finds or creates the student's transcript RagDocument, populates it for ingestion, and saves it, incrementing the ingestion version on re-ingestion.

nodes.name: startGlobalKnowledge
nodes.summary: Creates a new global-scope admin knowledge RagDocument, populates it for ingestion, and saves it.

nodes.name: sha256
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-256 hex checksum of an uploaded file's bytes.

nodes.name: RagVectorStoreServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation replacing document chunks in the vector store with metadata tags and deleting chunks via direct JDBC.

nodes.name: replaceDocumentChunks
nodes.summary: Deletes existing chunks for a document, tags new chunks with document id, scope, source type, filename, and owner, then adds them to the vector store.

nodes.name: deleteDocumentChunks
nodes.summary: Deletes all vector store chunks associated with a document id via a direct JDBC update.

nodes.name: SupabaseStorageServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Implementation performing REST calls against Supabase's storage buckets for avatars, chat files, transcripts, and course materials, plus generating signed download URLs.

nodes.name: uploadAvatar
nodes.summary: Validates and uploads a user avatar image to Supabase's avatar bucket via REST, returning the public URL.

nodes.name: uploadChatFile
nodes.summary: Validates and uploads a chat attachment to the chat bucket with a UUID-prefixed filename.

nodes.name: uploadTranscript
nodes.summary: Validates and uploads a student transcript PDF to the transcript bucket with a UUID-prefixed filename.

nodes.name: uploadCourseMaterial
nodes.summary: Uploads course material content to the course-material bucket via REST, handling errors from the external Supabase API.

nodes.name: signCourseMaterial
nodes.summary: Requests a time-limited signed URL for a course material object from Supabase's storage API.

nodes.name: uploadFile
nodes.summary: Shared helper that performs the actual authenticated PUT/POST upload of a file's bytes to a Supabase storage bucket and returns the resulting public URL.

nodes.name: VirtualMentorServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Core implementation of the virtual mentor: creates/renames/deletes chat sessions, retrieves messages, and streams RAG-augmented chat responses scoped to the authenticated user.

nodes.name: createSession
nodes.summary: Creates a new chat session for the authenticated user with the given name.

nodes.name: getUserSessions
nodes.summary: Retrieves all chat sessions belonging to the authenticated user.

nodes.name: getSessionMessages
nodes.summary: Retrieves chat message history for a session, verifying the session belongs to the requesting user.

nodes.name: renameSession
nodes.summary: Renames a chat session after verifying ownership by the authenticated user.

nodes.name: deleteSession
nodes.summary: Deletes a chat session after verifying ownership by the authenticated user.

nodes.name: streamChat
nodes.summary: Core streaming chat method: persists the user message, retrieves scoped RAG context from the vector store, builds a prompt, and streams the LLM's response back while saving the assistant reply.

nodes.name: retrievableBy
nodes.summary: Builds the vector-store filter expression restricting RAG retrieval to documents visible to the given user (global scope plus their own private documents).

nodes.name: augmentWithAttachment
nodes.summary: Appends the content of an attached file to the chat message, truncating to a maximum character limit.

nodes.name: buildSystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Renders the system prompt template with the user's and student's profile data for personalized mentor responses.

nodes.name: getAuthenticatedUser
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently authenticated user from the security context via the user repository.

nodes.name: FileValidationUtil
nodes.summary: Static utility class holding size/type/extension constraints and validation methods for images, PDFs, and chat attachments.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Shared validation logic checking a file is non-empty, under the max size, has an allowed extension, and has an allowed content type, throwing BadRequestException otherwise.

nodes.name: extensionOf
nodes.summary: Extracts and lowercases the file extension from a filename.

nodes.name: RagDocumentServiceTest
nodes.summary: Test class covering RagDocumentServiceImpl's transcript ingestion start behavior including private scope defaults and version incrementing on re-ingestion.

nodes.name: RagVectorStoreServiceTest
nodes.summary: Test class covering RagVectorStoreServiceImpl's chunk replacement and deletion behavior.

nodes.name: VirtualMentorServiceSecurityContextTest
nodes.summary: Test class verifying VirtualMentorServiceImpl's authenticated-user resolution and access-control behavior via the security context.
